description: CoinGecko per-exchange market depth for one coin: USD cost to move price up 2% and down 2% (liquidity), 24h volume in USD, last price and bid-ask spread, for the 15 highest-volume trading pairs. Each row is one exchange pair, not a merged order book. Data is CoinGecko's, updated on its own schedule. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

coin.description: CoinGecko coin id, e.g. bitcoin, ethereum, solana
